concept_decisions: Concept A sets warm narrow tubular silhouette and pale fans. Reject its oversized collar-like body rings and small scattered dorsal-looking fans: use shallow real segment constrictions on continuous soft body, 25 paired stations with equant upper/lower lateral lobes and fan bristles on all stations. Head at -Y with exactly two smooth forward palps; posterior +Y short taper, no tail filament. Fan 4 tapered volumetric bristles per ramus with tiny bifid tips represented by paired terminal twigs; counts are visual simplification, not exact fossil chaetal count. Gently S-curved body, modest flattening, no substrate. Fine individual bristles readable mainly top/hero, canonical axial views necessarily foreshorten slender animal. Entire organism persists in full volume.
